nom: Doll 10 Overnight Facial Daily Dissolve Enzyme Cleansing Balm

segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin reports the product left her face very dry, red and itchy around the eyes, while others describe it as non-drying and even hydrating.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several say it caused no breakouts, no stinging and no irritation even around sensitive eyes, but two report breakouts and swollen eyes on sensitive skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s and 60s describe smoother, moisturized skin and one calls it good for mature skin generally.
segments.combination: No combination-specific reports are given in the reviews supplied.

concerns.aging: One reviewer cites niacinamide and noni for anti-aging benefit and another in her 60s says her skin is the best it has ever been; no reviewer reports a negative effect on aging skin specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report skin feels soft, smooth, hydrated or moisturized afterward and not dried out; one reviewer with dry skin reports the opposite, describing her face becoming very dry after use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports it calmed her redness; one reviewer reports new redness and itchiness after use, and another explicitly notes no redness occurred.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers generally describe the balm as gentle and non-irritating to the skin barrier, with no stinging or burning reported by most, though one reviewer's skin reacted with dryness, redness and itchiness.
concerns.spots: No reviewer discusses spots or hyperpigmentation specifically.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer states the balm never clogs her pores and even helps her skin, one says it caused no breakouts despite sensitive skin, but one other reviewer with sensitive skin reports breaking out from the product.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers highlight that it rinses off with no oily or greasy residue despite being a balm; one reviewer expected an oily finish given the oil-like texture but found it was not oily.

aspects.libelle: Melts off makeup including eye makeup
Rinses off with no greasy residue
